question: Could you get to the site twice a month?
rendered: I think it would be tough. I rely on public transport, and sometimes buses don't run when they're supposed to. Also, I have to take time off work, but that costs money, and I can't always afford it. The site is quite far away too, so even if the bus runs on time, it might still be a long journey. And with my COPD, traveling and waiting are already hard for me.
